source.title: Curse of Ula'tek Housing Updates: New Blueprints, Pets, and More Arrive for Your Home
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Housing dye pigments are also being retired
notes: NEW method-identity boundary, not a source of numeric War Within Milling yields. Blizzard states post-12.1 Alchemy/Inscription converts herbs directly into housing dyes at a dye station and retires housing pigments. Original 2025 player instructions and a 2025 housing guide describe the older 10-herb-to-1 housing-pigment process; Wowhead's later first-hand Tequima comment distinguishes that earlier housing salvage operation from ordinary Inscription Milling ('Scribes: make sure you don't Mill them by mistake!'). The 12.1 dye recipes include Mycobloom (210796/210797/210798 by quality) to Brown Housing Dye (274469) or White Housing Dye (274474) at the station, not standard Nacreous Pigment (222618/222619/222620) milling. Do not treat 10:1 housing dye as a Mycobloom milling yield, infer a per-cast histogram, include dyes in normal milling ItemDB outputs, or apply frozen gold values; different method and dated patches. No fresh post-hotfix independent baseline cohort, completed milling operation log, per-material hits/zeros, skill/specialization or refund data was found. This search is novel method-disambiguation; previously exhausted generic ore/milling studies are not duplicated.
lookingFor: Verify whether a newly indexed 10-herb Mycobloom housing dye conversion is an eligible Khaz Algar normal Milling -> Nacreous Pigment numeric source and whether dye output IDs can fill null TWW milling fields
